{
  "sop_id": "SOP-017",
  "title": "Vendor onboarding",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Open onboarding ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Collect registration form and statutory documents", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Check PAN, GSTIN and MSME status on government portals", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Request Finance to validate bank account", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Request Legal/Compliance for sanctions, blacklist and conflict-of-interest screening", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S6", "name": "Assess vendor's capability and quality", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S7", "name": "Assign risk category and confirm payment terms, NDA and code-of-conduct acknowledgement", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S8", "name": "Draft vendor master record", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S9", "name": "Submit vendor master record", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge review", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A2", "name": "Lead approval", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A3", "name": "HOD approval and activation", "role": "HOD", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Correct and resubmit rejected onboarding", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"},
    {"step_id": "D1", "name": "Wait for Finance validation", "role": "Executor", "type": "decision"},
    {"step_id": "D2", "name": "Wait for Legal/Compliance screening", "role": "Executor", "type": "decision"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "HOD", "condition": "always"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"dep_id": "D1", "provider": "Finance", "item": "bank account validation", "parallel_group": "P1"},
    {"dep_id": "D2", "provider": "Legal/Compliance", "item": "sanctions, blacklist and conflict-of-interest screening", "parallel_group": "P1"}
  ],
  "rework_reasons": [
    "Required document missing",
    "Incorrect category",
    "Amount mismatch",
    "Wrong quantity"
  ],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.85
}
